steps.content:
2:50 AM, unspecified date, N.F. 115
Suite A502, Embassy Hotel

The opened suite door shows no signs of forced entry, and all windows remain tightly shut. Yet Mr. Wei, who should normally be in bed, is nowhere to be found. Only a faint trace of wisteria fragrance lingers in the room.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the hotel's surveillance footage is heavily distorted by Mania interference. We could only salvage a few frames. At 1 AM, Mr. Wei's wheelchair was seen pulled out of the hotel by some strange vines.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: All hotel staff fell temporarily unconscious at the time. Likely Yingying's doing as well.
You examine the surveillance footage closely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no trace of fear or panic on his face. Instead, he appears to be having a pleasant conversation with someone, looking much more spirited than when you last met.
You attempt to sense with your shackles, but can only detect the remains of that massive wisteria standing in the city. The branches are too small to track.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Wei, time is running out and we need every lead we can get. I hope you'll be completely honest with us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mr. Wei didn't come here just to rebuild the fete, did he? His real target was the incarnation from your legends, right?
Wei Ziyi sits on the nearby sofa, her eyes red-rimmed, one hand pressed against her forehead in visible exhaustion.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: My great-granduncle hadn't been lucid enough to speak with us for a long time. But when he heard that the Wisteria Fairy had awakened in DisCity, he suddenly became agitated and insisted I get involved.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: I know he still yearns for the old days and I understand his determination to preserve those old tales. But I don't know why he pushed himself so hard to come here. It must be some deep-rooted desire he's been harboring all this time.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: But one thing is certain.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: Even if equipped with Hypercubes, anyone who gets near the Wisteria in its current state will suffer from corruption. For someone as critically ill as him, the risk would be far greater.
She rises to her feet, places her hands over her heart, and bows deeply before you.

steps.speaker: Ziyi
steps.content: I implore you...
Her words carry unmistakable honesty. You take a deep breath, gradually unclenching your fists.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know where Yingying has taken him. Let's head to the Wisteria remains.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: This place... this is...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't you recognize it? This is the fete you've been so eager to visit.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...The same one from a hundred years ago that you missed.
The place is vibrant and lively. Crowds of festivalgoers fill the streets as vendors' calls echo through the air.
Every passerby wears a genuine smile, their eyes bright with hope for tomorrow.
The elderly man takes an instinctive step forward, suddenly aware that his once-frail body now feels incredibly light and agile.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: How... What's happened to my body?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Now that you're here, you should be allowed to enjoy it as your younger self, and have some fun!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: My power won't last as long as it used to. Better make the most of it while you can, right?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Shouldn't you be looking for someone?

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I... I understand.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Farewell, Wisteria Fairy!
He runs a few steps, then suddenly remembers something, and turns back to shout.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Thank you!
Yingying watches the boy run off, then stretches contentedly.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Now... what should I do next?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: First, explain to me exactly what you did.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Eek! Sweetheart, you startled me!

options: You nearly gave me a heart attack too.

choices.text: You nearly gave me a heart attack too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not a note, not even a single word. You simply vanished without a trace. That's not good for my heart, you know.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hmm? Were you... worried about me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, I was worried. Worried you'd drained yourself completely and would never wake up again. Or you'd be captured and sent back to Eastia. Or you'd agree to their terms and leave DisCity forever.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm so happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a serious matter. You left the Bureau without permission, then took Mr. Wei from his hotel, and brought him to this dangerous place. It's my duty to escort both of you back.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Oh, so it's not me you were worried about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because... Mr. Wei and his associates brought a technique from Eastia today. They suggested they could transplant your wisteria back to Eastia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've been terribly weak these past few days, but when he brought out the soil from Eastia and transplanted you into that pot, it did revive you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I consulted Wuhuanzi, and even she admitted that the Eastian environment would be highly beneficial for your speedy recovery.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So you thought I would leave with them? That I would abandon DisCity?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course I don't want you to leave, but if staying here puts your life at risk, I'd rather...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Shhh...
She presses her index finger to your lips.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't say it if you don't mean it.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I won't leave, just as Mr. Wei never would.
She lowers her finger with a smile, takes your hand, and leads you back to the Wisteria Pavilion.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Long ago, he made a wish to take his "Little Orchid" to the fete here.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: That wish has transcended from that fete a century ago to this very day...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Even as his life drew to a close, his determination only grew stronger. He journeyed from afar, willing to spend his last breath here if needed. And that roused me.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Tell me, how could I not honor such dedication?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Now Mr. Wei has come here, like a drop of fresh water joining a pool, and his task is to find that girl he loves among the thousands gathered at the fete.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: This will be a long search reserved only for him. Come, let's help him along his way.
[Scene transition: Wisteria Pavilion]
You arrive at the Wisteria Pavilion with Yingying, where craftsmen are putting the finishing touches on a prayer altar beneath the wisteria tree.
Above them, pale purple wisteria buds are beginning to bloom, their petals scattered across the offering table below.

steps.speaker: Hawker A
steps.content: Look, it's the Wisteria Fairy! The prayer ceremony is tomorrow. Shouldn't you be preparing at the Wisteria Pavilion instead of wandering about?

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Oh hush now! What a fine young companion you have there... Here, have some of my fried fruit. May it bring you a harmonious union!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I should thank YOU. The stalls are much grander than last year. I'm sure everyone who comes to pray will be delighted.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: As you can see, the wisteria has bloomed earlier this year. Would you please spread the word that we'll begin the prayer ceremony today?

steps.speaker: Hawker A
steps.content: Oh, that's perfect! These past few years, we could only have the ceremony on the last day. The place became so packed that some folks could only pray from afar. I'll go and tell everyone!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: In that case... could I be the first to pray? My wife is due in two months. Please bless us with a safe delivery, dear Fairy.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Of course. The Wisteria Fairy has heard your prayer. Stay by your wife's side, and she will surely have a safe and smooth delivery.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Fortune may favor you, but remember to do your part as well.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Of course! Thank you, Fairy. Take these treats as my thank-you offering for you and your date here. When my child is born, I'll treat you both to celebration eggs!

steps.speaker: Hawker B
steps.content: Me! Let me be next!
This is your first time seeing Yingying addressing the prayers of Yunhuai's residents one by one as the Wisteria Fairy.

She sits gracefully upon her dais, listening attentively to everyone's words. She records their wishes on tags while you hang them on the wisteria tree. The residents quickly warm to you, the Wisteria Fairy's new assistant.
But this isn't just a time for blessings and good wishes.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: What?! That scoundrel swindled you out of sixteen pieces of silver! How absolutely outrageous!

steps.speaker: Hawker B
steps.content: That's right! That lying bastard! I hope misfortune follows him for the rest of his life!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: A lifetime is a bit too much... Let's make it a year of misfortune instead. I'll note down your wish!
...The prayers go on.
The sun sinks as time slowly drifts by.
At last, you and Yingying meet the person you're waiting for.
A round-faced young girl approaches the prayer altar. She kneels down reverently, takes some snacks from her pocket to place on the offering table, and begins her prayer in a soft voice.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Revered Wisteria Fairy, I am Youlan from Valleyville at the river's end.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Please hear my prayer. There's a boy I'm into. He'd call me little orchid, but he's so dense when it comes to this sort of thing... When will he finally take the hint?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Hehe.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: We've been neighbors since childhood. Mom says we even shared the same baby clothes when we were little.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: When I gave him flowers, he gave me a handful of wildflowers in return. I shared my candy with him, and he slipped me some persimmon cakes. I'm not good at embroidery, so I made him some leaf ornaments... and he... he gave me three beautiful beaded flowers in return. I heard he spent a whole month's salary on them.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: I'm really fond of him... I just don't know if he feels the same way about me.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Mom says if he likes me, he'll tell me himself... but when? I've been waiting since last year, and now this year is almost over too.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Oh, Wisteria Fairy, if you can hear me, please give him a little push.
A gentle evening breeze rustles by, and a cluster of wisteria flowers quietly blooms above the young girl's head. Hidden in the tree, the other one pinches her nose and speaks.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Shall I tell him in his dream? Or perhaps change his heart? You see, I can't force him to come to you. But why don't you just ask him yourself?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Whatever he might think, at least you're sure about how you feel about him, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: He... he's been ill...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Shall I cure his illness? Or perhaps arrange a chance encounter between you two?

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Oh, no no no! I... I'm afraid he doesn't like me. That would be so embarrassing.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Haha, there's nothing embarrassing about having feelings for someone! Whether he accepts them or not is his business, and your feelings are your own. It's not like you're causing him any trouble.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I can't promise to make him fall in love with you, but...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since you've made a wish, I should do something about it...
Just then, as if on cue, the courtyard's door knocker rings.
It's as if time is beginning to flow again after going still for ages, in sync with his advancing footsteps.
He rushes forward.
With each stride, it feels as though time itself is turning backward.
A devotion that has lasted a hundred years finally finds its reunion in the present.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: You're still running a fever! What are you thinking, coming here like this?

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Eh?

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: Come here, let me see if the Wisteria Fairy has really cured you.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: W-wait, there's something... something I must tell you. Please, listen to me first.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: I've walked all the way from home to the fete just to tell you this... The trip has taken me so very long.

steps.speaker: Youlan
steps.content: ...Go ahead then. I'm listening.

steps.speaker: Boy
steps.content: Let's never be apart again, shall we?
(Fade in a slow white light effect)

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Thank you, Wisteria Fairy.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Please give this to my Ziyi, and tell her I won't be coming back.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: I also hope... your wishes come true.
(White light fades - Under the wisteria tree)
A paper crane drifts into Yingying's palm, and she carefully tucks it away.
As you watch the two figures disappear into the distance, Yingying gently grips your hand.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: May I borrow a little more of your Qi, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I want this illusion to last just a little longer.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Because when this dream ends, we'll both need to move forward.
[Scene transition: Wisteria ruins]
Dawn slowly breaks.
As you emerge from the illusion, you see the FAC's patrol vehicles have completely surrounded the area around the wisteria remains.
Yingying is gone, leaving only a single wisteria branch in your hand.
The elderly man beside you has drawn his last breath, but his face is perfectly serene, as if he has returned to his youth once more.
